answer_text: A Cisco ASA returns TS_UNACCEPTABLE because ASA typically supports only a single Traffic Selector (TS) per IKEv2 child SA, while Cato’s default behavior is to send multiple TS in a single proposal. The fix is to enable the IKEv2 option to send a single TS per payload, so the ASA accepts the proposal. This can be configured at the account level or per IPsec site (Site Configuration > Advanced Configuration) by turning on “IKEv2 Send Single TS per Payload” (On), after which only one TS is sent per child SA.
